principle: A NICE Work Role is a grouping of work, not automatically a job or AXM profession.

boundaries.label: Software Security Assessment
boundaries.axm_effect: Supports application/software security assessment and actionable verification evidence inside AppSec scope.

boundaries.label: Secure Software Development
boundaries.axm_effect: Implementation ownership remains with software engineering; AppSec supplies requirements/review/evidence.

boundaries.label: DevSecOps competency/work
boundaries.axm_effect: Pipeline/infrastructure integration must compose with DevOps rather than be absorbed by AppSec.

boundaries.label: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
boundaries.axm_effect: Application dependency evidence may hand off into organization-wide supplier/component risk management; organizational C-SCRM is not silently imported.

boundaries.label: Incident Response
boundaries.axm_effect: Evidence of active compromise hands off to incident response rather than expanding AppSec authority.

update_rule: Pin NICE version and explicitly remap renamed/deprecated components; never transfer role equivalence silently.
